# Claude Cream

Claude Cream is a minimal, paper-like light theme that embeds the Anthropic Serif, Sans and Mono fonts so typography renders offline. Live Preview editing and Reading view are aligned at the same 752px width and 1.65 line height, and the interface uses clay-orange accents, hand-drawn checkboxes, wavy underlines and refined borders for cards, tables and callouts.

![Claude Cream screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tttnny/obsidian-claude-cream/HEAD/screenshot.png)
